name: confessions
description: Anonymous confessions with titles, threaded reply trees, reply DMs with opt-out, cooldowns, and hash-based moderator bans.

configFields.label: Confession Channel
configFields.description: Channel where anonymous confessions are posted.

configFields.label: Moderation Log
configFields.description: Optional channel that records confession and reply audits with irreversible author hashes, never raw identities.

configFields.label: Report Log Channel
configFields.description: Optional channel that receives reports submitted through the Report button. Reports are only sent here, never stored with author identities.

configFields.label: Report Ping Role
configFields.description: Optional role mentioned (without notification) in report messages sent to the report log channel.

configFields.label: Auto-Thread
configFields.description: Create a discussion thread under each confession for anonymous replies.

configFields.label: Allow Image Uploads
configFields.description: Allow an optional image upload on confessions and replies.

configFields.label: Reply DM Notifications
configFields.description: DM the parent author when someone replies to their confession or reply. People can opt out from the DM itself.

configFields.label: Cooldown (minutes)
configFields.description: Minimum gap between confessions from the same author.

endUserDataStatement: Stores a per-guild random salt, irreversible SHA-256 author hashes used only for bans and cooldowns, confession titles and text, rehosted upload URLs, message and thread IDs, reply paths, counters, and report markers holding only a timestamp. Raw user IDs are stored only to deliver reply DM notifications and honour DM opt-outs, and are erasable through the module data-deletion request. Reporters are named only in the report message sent to the configured report channel, not in stored data.
